description:
### Added
- **In-app patch settings (`PatchSettingsPatch`):**
  - Clean Instagram-style full-screen **`MaterialTidal`** settings menu inside TIDAL's main Settings screen (`Settings → MaterialTidal`) with Quick Controls, organized category sub-pages for all 50 patch options, custom 24dp vector icons, flat grouped cards, spring-animated M3 switches, connected segmented buttons, thick-track sliders, per-page or full reset, and smart Reload UI / Restart prompts.
- **Seamless track transitions (`CrossfadePlaybackPatch`):**
  - Dual-player Crossfade playback with configurable duration (`0–12 s`), 4 audio fade curves (`Equal Power`, `Smooth S-Curve`, `Soft Dip`, `DJ Blend`), adjustable blend intensity (`0–100%`), optional gapless-album preservation, live curve visualizer, and clean full-screen **Crossfade** menu in Settings and Now Playing.
- **Song waveform seekbar (`WaveformSeekbarPatch`):**
  - Optional track-derived animated audio waveform seekbar with mirrored/bottom/smooth styles, configurable bar density (`36` / `56` / `76`), scrub zoom, and real-time beat pulse reactivity.
- **Unified Morphe Patcher metadata:**
  - Standardized `M3 ...` patch naming and clean user-facing option descriptions noting live customization via `Settings → MaterialTidal`.
- **Desktop-inspired Tablet & Wide-Screen Fullscreen Player (`ExpressivePlayerView`, `PlayerDesktopLayoutSolver`, `DesktopQueuePanelRenderer`, `ExpressivePlayQueueController`):**
  - **Two-Pane Desktop Landscape Mode** (`>= 600dp` wide landscape/large tablets/foldables/DeX): large 1:1 Hero Cover squircle on the left (smoothly centering in Artwork Focus mode when collapsing the side panel) paired with a frosted right-hand panel switching with spring animation between an interactive **Play Queue** (live `NOW PLAYING`, `UP NEXT`, and `NEXT FROM <SOURCE>` sections, tap-to-play, one-tap remove, and full-sheet expand) and side-by-side **Lyrics** (keeping the hero cover full-size).
  - **3-Zone Floating Desktop Playback Dock**: Left track metadata + favorite heart, Center `[Shuffle | Prev | Play/Pause | Next | Repeat]` with inline wavy seekbar and timestamps, and Right `[Lyrics | Queue | Cast]` connected pills + interactive system volume slider + live stream spec quality pill (e.g. `24-BIT · 192 kHz FLAC`).
  - **Refined Tablet Portrait Mode & Sheet Sizing**: centered editorial column widths (`<= 540dp` player controls, `<= 440dp` cover & bottom capsule, `<= 620dp` lyrics measure), header source pill, and bounded `<= 560dp` Play Queue modal sheet on tablets.
  - Added `tabletDesktopLayout` patch option (enabled by default) and `VerifyTabletPlayerLayout` unit test suite (`:patches:verifyTabletPlayerLayout`).
- **Expressive expand-and-push-back player transport buttons (`ExpressivePlayerView`):**
  - Tapping or holding **Previous**, **Play/Pause**, or **Next** in either the Now Playing screen or the full-screen Lyrics view dynamically expands the pressed button into a squircle while neighboring buttons smoothly compress and push back with bouncy spring recoil, directional icon motion, subtle vertical lift, and tonal highlight.
- **Standalone `Syllable-synced karaoke lyrics` patch** *(depends on `Material 3 Expressive full player`, enabled by default)*:
  - Multi-provider syllable- and word-synced lyrics cascade (`lrc.red` direct ISRC, `lrc.red/api/v1`, `lrc.red` search, BetterLyrics multi-host, LyricsPlus multi-mirror pool with HTTP 429 cooldown, LRCLIB word-synced YAML `lyricsfile`, and KuGou KRC) with automatic ISRC caching, HTTPS redirect following, and **LRCLIB** line-synced fallback when TIDAL itself has no lyrics.
  - Sub-millisecond playback clock synchronized to TIDAL's native `ProgressTracker` with smooth 120fps frame interpolation.
  - 3-stop luminous feathered syllable sweep gradient, progress-coupled buoyant active-word lift springs with sustained vocal swell and staggered wave settle, elastic per-line cascade parallax scroll, right-aligned duet vocals, stacked background vocals, and floating animated instrumental break dots.
  - Hardware-accelerated GPU progressive depth-of-field blur (`lyricsProgressiveBlur`, `lyricsBlurStrength`) on inactive lyric lines that clears smoothly on focus or while browsing.
  - Pure-JVM unit test suite (`:patches:verifySyllableLyrics`).
- **Compact aligned Playlist secondary action bar (`ExpressivePlaylistController`, `ExpressiveMediaStyleKit`, `ExpressivePlaylistPatch`):**
  - Removed header Search/Sort pills to restore TIDAL's toolbar controls directly, removed circular icon backgrounds, unified all standard buttons (`Favorite`, `Edit`, `Privacy`, `Share`) and `DownloadSecondaryActionButton` to a sleek `56dp` height (`20dp` outer / `8dp` inner connected corners), exact `20dp` icons and centered `11sp` labels on identical vertical baselines, z-ordered & color-filter-cleared download icon/ring alignment, WCAG-verified foreground contrast, smooth neighbor-push spring physics, and a new `hidePlaylistActionButtons` patch option to hide the entire row completely.
- **Tap-anchored Material 3 Expressive menus for Song & Playlist actions + crisp vector icons (`ExpressiveBottomSheetStyler`, `ExpressiveContextMenuIcons`, `MaterialYouColorEngine`):**
  - Converted Song-Actions (`BottomSheetTrackHeader`) and Playlist-Actions (`BottomSheetPlaylistHeader`) from full-width bottom sheets into true tap-anchored `268dp` Material 3 Expressive menus (`22dp` rounded corners, subtle `0.14` dim, upward/downward flip anchoring around the tapped button, slim `60dp` integrated header with divider, borderless `44dp` rows with subtle muted destructive styling instead of filled red highlight cards, flicker-free layout-ready single reveal animation, and instant outside-tap & back dismissal).
  - Replaced context menu icons with custom crisp `24dp`-grid Material 3 Expressive vector drawables rendered cleanly at `20dp` with high contrast (`ExpressiveContextMenuIcons`) across all Song & Playlist actions.

### Fixed
- **Lyrics not updating when skipping tracks in Lyrics View (`ExpressivePlayerBridge`, `ExpressivePlayerView`, `SyllableLyricsFetcher`):**
  - Resolved and validated track metadata (`trackId`, `albumTitle`, `trackIsrc`, `durationMs`, and queue `MediaItem.getTitle()`) atomically before evaluating lyric state so lagged queue ISRC/track metadata from the previous song can never poison or stall skipped songs, suppressed transient stale native lyric frames, and preserved Lyrics View seamlessly across skips even when a track falls back to external/LRCLIB lyrics.

patches.name: In-app patch settings
patches.description: Adds a 'MaterialTidal' menu inside TIDAL's main Settings screen so you can toggle and customize installed MaterialTidal patches live without re-patching, with quick controls, organized sub-pages, and per-page or full reset.

patches.name: Linn Majik DSM Wi-Fi playback
patches.description: Discovers Linn DS/DSM OpenHome speakers on your local Wi-Fi in TIDAL's Devices sheet and streams Lossless or Hi-Res FLAC audio with full transport, queue, hardware volume, and lockscreen controls.

options.description: Audio quality streamed to Linn Majik DSM over Wi-Fi; Hi-Res remuxes 24-bit/192 kHz lossless audio cleanly (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Local HTTP Proxy supports all Linn DSM/1–5 generations including bit-perfect 24-bit/192 kHz FLAC (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Automatically wakes the Linn Majik DSM from standby and switches its source to Playlist when selected in TIDAL (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Optional LAN IP address (e.g. 192.168.1.50 or 192.168.1.50:55178) if automatic Wi-Fi discovery is blocked (also editable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 albums, artists & library
patches.description: Extends M3 design (fading hero artwork, adaptive Monet colors, pill controls, and a Bento-style Collection tile grid) to Albums, Artists, My Tracks, and your Library.

options.description: Apply fading hero artwork, adaptive Monet colors, pill controls, and connected action bars to Album pages and My Albums (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Apply fading portrait heroes, adaptive Monet colors, contributor chips, pill controls, and connected action bars to Artist pages and My Artists (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Apply Monet pill Play/Shuffle controls, a tonal Offline Download card, and polished track rows to My Tracks (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Redesigns the Library collection menu into a Bento-style tile grid with circular tonal top-bar buttons (also toggleable in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 bottom sheets & menus
patches.description: Redesigns Song & Playlist action menus as clean tap-anchored M3 popups with crisp vector icons, alongside rounded bottom sheets, grouped menu cards, overflow menus, and M3 dialogs.

options.description: Controls corner roundness for bottom sheets, popup menus, and dialogs across TIDAL (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Style track, album, playlist, and settings bottom-sheet rows as grouped tonal cards (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Apply rounded Monet containers, clean spacing, and pill ripples to overflow and dropdown menus (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Upgrade pop-up confirmation and selection dialogs with rounded Monet surfaces and pill action buttons (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 full player
patches.description: Redesigns the Now Playing screen with a blurred cover-art backdrop, adaptive Monet colors, animated squiggly seekbar, expressive transport controls, responsive tablet two-pane layout, full-screen lyrics, and a refreshed Play Queue.

options.description: Controls how the blurred album-art background and tonal accents are rendered (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Swipe the album cover horizontally with spring tilt physics to skip to the next or previous track (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Animates the active progress line as a Material 3 wave while playing; automatically replaced when 'Song waveform seekbar' is active (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Redesigns the Play Queue and Suggested Tracks view with cover-adaptive backdrops, pill tabs, a spotlight active track card, and rounded rows (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Uses a two-pane layout with side-by-side Play Queue & Lyrics, a three-zone bottom playback dock, and volume slider on tablets and wide screens (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 homepage
patches.description: Redesigns the Homepage with rounded M3 shortcut and carousel cards, Monet-styled Vibe chips and top bar, pull-to-refresh support, and optional removal of promotional banners.

options.description: Corner radius style for album/playlist carousel artwork and quick-access shortcut cards (can also be changed in Settings → MaterialTidal; restart recommended).
Enables pull-to-refresh at the top of the Homepage feed (also toggleable in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Hides the top creator upload promotional banner on the Homepage (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Hides promotional banners shown between Homepage music carousels (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Hides merchandise shopping carousels from the Homepage (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 navbar & mini-player
patches.description: Replaces TIDAL's bottom bar and mini-player with a floating M3 split-pill navigation dock, detached Search button, and separate floating mini-player card with swipe gestures and progressive backdrop blur.

options.description: Color palette style for the floating navigation dock and mini-player (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Shows Home, Explore, and Library in the left pill and Search in the detached circle button, hiding the Uploads tab (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Swipe the floating mini-player left or right to skip tracks and pull up to expand the full-screen player (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Replaces the solid bottom fade behind the floating navigation dock and mini-player with a frosted progressive blur (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 playlist screen
patches.description: Redesigns Playlist pages with a full-bleed fading hero cover, cover-adaptive or Monet colors, pill Play/Shuffle controls, compact expressive action buttons (or full hide), scroll-morphing toolbar, and polished track rows.

options.description: Extract accent colors dynamically from each playlist cover or always follow your system Monet wallpaper (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Display playlist artwork edge-to-edge at the top with a smooth downward fade into the background (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Round track artwork corners and add pill touch ripples while keeping TIDAL's active-track indicator (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Hide the secondary playlist action bar (Favorite, Edit, Download, Privacy, Share; also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 search
patches.description: Redesigns Search & Explore with rounded Monet search bars, frosted sticky headers, expressive filter pills, and Monet-harmonized genre and browse cards.

options.description: Corner style used for the Search input bar across Explore and active search screens (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Style Browse/Explore genre tiles, pill tags, and navigation rows as tonal Material 3 cards (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Float scrolling Explore and Search results smoothly beneath a frosted blurred header bar (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: Material You dynamic theme
patches.description: Applies your Android wallpaper's Material You Monet colors, rounder M3 shapes, and smooth frosted-glass blur across TIDAL's surfaces, accents, and cards. Options can also be adjusted live in Settings → MaterialTidal.

options.description: Uses a pure #000000 Dark Mode background instead of a tinted dark surface while keeping Monet accents and elevated cards (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Controls how strongly your wallpaper's Monet colors tint app surfaces and cards (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Upgrades button, card, and container corners across TIDAL to rounder M3 squircle and pill shapes (can also be toggled in Settings → MaterialTidal; restart recommended).
Enables smooth hardware-accelerated blur on hero artwork fades, sticky toolbars, floating bars, menus, and sheets (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Controls the strength of progressive blur fades and frosted glass surfaces (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: Seamless track transitions (Crossfade)
patches.description: Unlocks dual-player Crossfade with adjustable duration (0–12 s), 4 audio fade curves, blend intensity, gapless-album preservation, and a clean full-screen Crossfade menu in Settings and the Now Playing menu.

options.description: Initial crossfade overlap length in seconds (adjustable live anytime in Settings → MaterialTidal, Audio & Playback, or the Now Playing menu).
Audio volume curve used when blending outgoing and incoming tracks (adjustable live in the Crossfade menu).
Controls how strongly both tracks overlap at the midpoint of a transition (adjustable from 0% to 100% in the Crossfade menu).
Plays consecutive tracks from the same album gaplessly without crossfading (can be toggled live in the Crossfade menu).

patches.name: Song waveform seekbar
patches.description: Replaces the player seekbar with an animated audio waveform generated from the playing track, featuring smooth track transitions, scrub zoom, and optional real-time beat pulse.

options.description: Visual style used to draw the song's audio waveform along the seekbar (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Number of bars or curve segments drawn across the waveform seekbar (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Makes the waveform subtly pulse with real-time audio loudness around the playhead (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: Syllable-synced karaoke lyrics
patches.description: Upgrades full-screen lyrics with word-by-word karaoke sweep highlighting, gentle lift physics, depth-of-field blur on inactive lines, duet layout, and open community lyric providers with automatic fallback to TIDAL lyrics.

options.description: Applies smooth depth-of-field blur to inactive lyric lines, clearing as each line enters focus or while scrolling (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Controls how strongly inactive lyric lines blur based on distance from the active line (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: System Light & Dark theme
patches.description: Adds a Material You Light Mode and automatically switches TIDAL between Light and Dark themes following your Android system setting (or locks to Light or Dark), adapting surfaces, icons, text contrast, dialogs, and system bars.

options.description: Switch TIDAL automatically between Light and Dark theme using Android's system setting, or lock it to Light or Dark (also switchable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: Track swipe gestures
patches.description: Adds spring-back left and right swipe actions to track rows across playlists, albums, search, and your library (Add to Queue, Play Next, Favorite, or Add to Playlist).

options.description: Action triggered when swiping a track row to the right (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Action triggered when swiping a track row to the left (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Vibrate subtly when crossing the swipe threshold and triggering an action (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).
Horizontal drag distance in dp required to trigger a swipe action (36–160; also adjustable live via slider in Settings → MaterialTidal).
